method: Original PC x86 functions with actual decoded TER triangles and synthetic in-memory query state. No game, OS API, callback replacement, or original modification.

contracts.triangle: Interior front-to-back zero-radius ray hits first triangles; no edge/capsule or second-triangle assertion. Triangles are sampled from every terrain carrier containing usable faces.
contracts.transform: worldPoint[k]=x*M[k]+y*M[4+k]+z*M[8+k]+M[12+k]. Homogeneous w=0 excludes translation, including in-place output.
contracts.slide: out=v+n*(-dot(v,n)+0.0003). Variant0x678010 scales only the added Y term by global0x2947c00.
contracts.unobstructed: Position becomes (queryPosition+queryMovement), with Y multiplied by vertical stretch then radius*stretch removed. Ground-contact flag clears.

limits: These are bounded triangle, transform, deflection and no-hit response checks. Full swept ellipsoid broadphase/edge handling/moving-platform contacts remain incompletely tested.
Runtime query fixtures are constructed from decoded TER fields; original file-loader execution is not implied.
Native coordinates are preserved; no physical meter scale established.
